text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After a day out with Special Week, I walk her back to the dorm.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Hehe, today was so much fun!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: It feels different when I hang out with you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: It's not like when I go out with my mom or with my friends. I actually feel a little nervous…

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Oh! But I don't mean that in a bad way!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I think my excitement is turning into nervousness… It's hard to explain…

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: With my mom, we go to the farm across the road and help out…

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: And we hand out community notices to the old folks around the neighborhood.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Hang on a second… Does that even count as going out?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Actually, yeah it does! Going out doesn't always have to be to some special place. It's just gotta be fun, hehe!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Uhhh, El takes me to restaurants with super spicy food sometimes…

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: And with King, I take on giant ramen bowl challenges…

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Hold up. Is eating all I do? Aww, that's kinda embarrassing…
